verdict.rationale: Undermind exposes developer surfaces (an MCP server and enterprise API access), so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for it. The vendor's MCP reference states there is "no test environment". Access is user-scoped OAuth with no separate isolated mode, so nothing in the evidence shows a way to test without touching real workspace data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
